Senses.Explanation: The formula closes an address by directing the assembly to inspect the teaching just enacted before them. Senior seats, rectors, and closing-hammer officers utter it after the presiding teacher’s address. One presiding teacher puts the same formula into the firm-earth deity’s praise after a staff display, showing that the line certifies the completed presentation rather than defining its content.
